purpose: Independent practice of D1.3 — pictograph construction with title, labels, and one-to-one correspondence.
student_learning_goal: I can make a pictograph with pictures, a title, and labels.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can make a pictograph with pictures, a title, and labels.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot in the top-right corner with a pictograph. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Look at the pictograph. Write the title and the labels.
parts.visual_layout: A pictograph showing 3 rows of fruit pictures (3 apples, 5 bananas, 2 grapes) with row labels missing. Above the pictograph, a blank line for the title. Beside each row, a blank line for the label.

image_placeholders.description: A 3-row pictograph for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Row 1: 3 apples drawn in a horizontal line. Row 2: 5 bananas. Row 3: 2 grapes. Each picture ~0.6in across, evenly spaced. Above the pictograph, an empty line ~5in long (no title yet). Beside each row, an empty line ~1.5in long (no labels yet). Designed for the child to fill in title and labels.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_PICTOGRAPH at Part 1: instructions ask the child to write title and labels. Keywords name the visual elements (pictograph, fruits).

parts.answer_key: Title: 'Favourite Fruit' (or any sensible title). Labels: Row 1 = Apples, Row 2 = Bananas, Row 3 = Grapes.

parts.part_title: Part 2: Build a pictograph from a tally chart.
parts.student_instructions: The tally chart shows 4 categories. Build the pictograph with one picture per tally.
parts.visual_layout: Top: a tally chart with 4 rows: Pets — Dogs ||||CROSS (5), Cats |||| (4), Fish ||| (3), Birds || (2). Below: a blank pictograph grid with 4 pre-labelled rows but no pictures.

image_placeholders.description: A two-section worksheet area for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Top section: a tally chart with 4 rows showing Pets data. Each row has a label (Dogs, Cats, Fish, Birds), a tally area showing the marks (5, 4, 3, 2), and a total box. Bottom section: a blank pictograph grid with 4 pre-labelled rows (Dogs, Cats, Fish, Birds) but no pictures yet — empty cells for the child to draw pictures one-to-one. Each pictograph row has ~7 grid cells.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_TALLY_AND_GRID at Part 2: instructions ask the child to build a pictograph from tally data. Keywords name the source format (tally), target format (pictograph), and topic (pets).

parts.answer_key: Dogs row: 5 dog pictures. Cats row: 4 cat pictures. Fish row: 3 fish pictures. Birds row: 2 bird pictures. All pictures should be similar size, one per cell.

parts.part_title: Part 3: Make a pictograph from a family survey.
parts.student_instructions: Survey your family at home. Pick a question. Make a pictograph with title and labels.
parts.visual_layout: A blank pictograph grid (~5in × 4in) with 3 empty rows. Above the grid, a blank title line. Beside each row, a blank label line.

image_placeholders.description: A blank pictograph grid for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Grid is ~5in × 4in with 3 empty rows. Each row has ~6 cells with light dotted outlines (so the child knows where to place pictures). Above the grid, a thin blank line for the title. Beside each row, a blank line for the label. Designed for a home family survey.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_BLANK_GRID at Part 3: instructions ask the child to make a family survey pictograph. Keywords name the format (pictograph) and source (family).

parts.answer_key: Any valid pictograph with: a title, 3 labels, and one-to-one pictures matching the family survey data. Common: 'Favourite Season' with rows for Summer/Winter/Spring.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, add a 4th row to your family pictograph.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation artifact. Use Part 2 as the formative signal for one-to-one — children who place exactly one picture per tally have grasped the rule.
